note: Only publisher pages actually opened during the 11 November 2026 review are listed. An official link validates the cited general rule or public series, not any property's private amount or a future result.

irs_estate.title: Estate tax and filing threshold
irs_estate.evidence: The gross estate includes cash, securities, real estate and certain trusts; 2026 filing threshold $15,000,000; gifts and deductions matter.
irs_estate.checked: Opened full agency page; threshold table and gross-estate paragraphs.

irs_2027.title: 2027 inflation adjustments (IR-2026-133)
irs_2027.checked: Opened agency release dated 5 November 2026; Estate Tax Exclusion paragraph.

ca_no_tax.title: Revenue and Taxation Code §13301
ca_no_tax.evidence: State and its political subdivisions may not impose a gift, inheritance or estate tax under this section.

ca_estate.title: California estate tax
ca_estate.evidence: No California estate tax return required for deaths from 1 January 2005 under current rules.
ca_estate.checked: Opened agency explanation and filing-date bullets.

ftb_inherit.title: Gifts and inheritance
ftb_inherit.evidence: Inheritance itself not included in California income; subsequent rent, dividends, interest and sale gain may be taxed.
ftb_inherit.checked: Opened agency page and list of taxable subsequent income.

irs_basis.title: Inherited-property basis FAQ
irs_basis.evidence: Inherited basis generally FMV at death (or elected alternate date); sale above basis can produce taxable gain.
irs_basis.checked: Opened full FAQ and verified basis and reporting paragraphs.

irs_trust_basis.title: Revenue Ruling 2023-2
irs_trust_basis.evidence: An irrevocable grantor trust's assets not in gross estate generally do not obtain a §1014 basis adjustment merely because the grantor dies.
irs_trust_basis.checked: Opened ruling PDF and read issue, facts, law and holding.

irs_capital.title: Topic 409: capital gains
irs_capital.evidence: Capital gain is amount realized less adjusted basis; long-term rates vary by taxable income; unrecaptured §1250 gain has a special rate.
irs_capital.checked: Opened full topic, including capital-gain rate and exceptions sections.

irs_niit.title: Topic 559: net investment income tax
irs_niit.evidence: NIIT can apply at 3.8% to investment income above MAGI thresholds; includes rents and gains in some cases.
irs_niit.checked: Opened full topic and verified thresholds and definition.

irs_home_sale.title: Topic 701: home-sale exclusion
irs_home_sale.evidence: Up to $250,000 or $500,000 of eligible main-home gain; ownership and use tests generally require 2 of the 5 years before sale.
irs_home_sale.checked: Opened full topic and verified both tests and thresholds.

irs_rental.title: Publication 527: residential rental property
irs_rental.evidence: Rental income and expenses, mixed personal/rental use, repairs versus improvements, and building-only depreciation rules require documentation.
irs_rental.checked: Opened agency publication contents; specific rental and depreciation claims cross-checked against indexed sections.

irs_ira.title: Publication 590-B: inherited IRA distributions
irs_ira.evidence: A non-eligible designated beneficiary generally faces the 10-year inherited-IRA distribution rule; beneficiary and trust exceptions change timing.
irs_ira.checked: Opened current IRS publication; 10-year-rule wording verified via publisher search excerpt.

irs_filing.title: Filing estate and gift tax returns
irs_filing.evidence: Estate return generally due 9 months from death; 6-month filing extension available if requested before due date; paying tax has a separate rule.
irs_filing.checked: Opened agency When to file paragraph.

irs_706.title: Form 706 instructions (2026)
irs_706.evidence: Portability election requires timely Form 706; nine-month general deadline; tax payment may not be extended by merely extending filing.
irs_706.checked: Opened official instructions contents and read When To File / portability language via publisher excerpt.

ca_prop19.title: Proposition 19 guidance
ca_prop19.evidence: Eligible parent-child family home must be principal residence of both parties; homeowners exemption in 1 year and exclusion claim in 3 years/before third-party transfer.
ca_prop19.checked: Opened BOE comparison chart and filing periods; read statute for conditions.

ca_prop19_limit.title: Letter 2025/009: family-home amount
ca_prop19_limit.evidence: Value-limit add-on is about $1,044,590 (rounded from the official statutory figure) for transfers 16 Feb 2025–15 Feb 2027; later adjustments not yet published.
ca_prop19_limit.checked: Opened official letter PDF, date-range and amount table; public presentation rounded to $10.

ca_prop19_law.title: Revenue and Taxation Code §63.2
ca_prop19_law.evidence: Transferee principal-residence requirement, homeowners exemption and removal when eligibility ends.
ca_prop19_law.checked: Opened statutory subsection (a)(1)(A)-(C) and claim provision (b).

ca_change.title: Revenue and Taxation Code §60
ca_change.evidence: Property tax change in ownership is transfer of a present real-property interest including beneficial use.

ca_assess.title: Revenue and Taxation Code §51
ca_assess.evidence: Taxable assessment is generally the lesser of factored base-year value (inflation increase at most 2%) or market value at lien date; exceptions apply.

ca_assess_history.title: Letter 2026/002: 50 years of annual factors
ca_assess_history.evidence: Published year-by-year CCPI changes and Prop 13 factors 1976–77 through 2026–27; 2026 factor 1.02.
ca_assess_history.checked: Opened complete letter PDF, reproduced 50 transition rows directly into the public reference CSV.

ca_decline.title: Proposition 8 decline in value
ca_decline.evidence: Temporary assessment relief when market value drops below factored base-year value, and restoration can exceed 2% until reaching that base value.
ca_decline.checked: Opened whole agency explainer including restoration rule.

ca_trust_notice.title: Probate Code §16061.7
ca_trust_notice.evidence: Trustee notification to beneficiaries/heirs generally within 60 days after trigger, with statutory exceptions.

ca_death_report.title: Revenue and Taxation Code §480
ca_death_report.evidence: Death-triggered real-property transfer through trust: trustee/transferee generally files change-in-ownership statement with recorder or assessor within 150 days.
ca_death_report.checked: Opened statutory subsection (b) and reporting notice.
